rows.en: ＊Kairi＊＠０５１＿０１３Thank you!＝＠０５１＿０１４I'll work hard so I don't￥hold you back.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Kairi Depart　－

＊Kairi＊＠０５１＿０２７So I get to go to Elan...￥Without you, I would never￥have made it.＝＠０５１＿０２８I've always wanted to go...￥to Elan.＝＠０５１＿０２９My time here has been￥truly meaningful.＝＠０５１＿０３０That must be because you￥were here.

＊Kairi＊＠０５２＿００１While we were here, you helped￥me realize so many things.＝＠０５２＿００２I can never thank you enough.＝＠０５２＿００３Even if I had been the one￥choosing a partner,￥I would still have chosen you...＝＠０５２＿００４Thank you.

＊Kairi＊＠０５２＿００５While we were here, you helped￥me realize so many things.＝＠０５２＿００６I was truly lucky to meet you.＝＠０５２＿００７Even if I had been the one￥choosing a partner, I would have￥chosen you without hesitation...＝＠０５２＿００８Thank you.
